![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

To prevent a bootstrapping deadlock where `build-9709-qp-ms-completeness.mjs` cannot run on a clean repository because the legacy registry or Aliyun OSS artifacts do not exist yet, use the existing `readOptionalJson` helper with a fallback instead of `JSON.parse(await readFile(...))`. This allows the script to run first, generate the canonical freeze, and then let the Aliyun OSS gate script generate the remaining artifacts.

```suggestion
  const legacyRegistry = await readOptionalJson(root, LEGACY.registry, { registry: [] });
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When reading and parsing JSON input files, wrap the path resolution and file reading logic to catch errors and record diagnostics rather than throwing unhandled exceptions, ensuring the system fails closed gracefully.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Similarly, use `readOptionalJson` with an empty object fallback when reading the other legacy/Aliyun OSS artifacts in this loop. This ensures that if the Aliyun OSS gate has not been run yet (or if the artifacts are cleaned), the completeness script can still bootstrap successfully without throwing `ENOENT` errors.

```suggestion
  for (const [id, relative] of Object.entries(LEGACY).filter(([id]) => id !== 'registry')) {
    const value = await readOptionalJson(root, relative, {});
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The absolute path `'/home/samsen/code/ciecopilot-home/node_modules'` is hardcoded in the `candidates` array. This is highly non-portable and specific to a single local development environment, which will cause failures or redundant lookup attempts in CI/CD pipelines or on other developers' machines. Please remove this local path.

```suggestion
  const candidates = [path.join(root, 'node_modules'), path.resolve(root, '../..', 'node_modules')];
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The absolute path `'/home/samsen/code/ciecopilot-home/node_modules'` is hardcoded here as well. Please remove this local path to ensure portability across different development and CI environments.

```javascript
  const candidates = [
    path.join(root, 'node_modules'),
    path.resolve(root, '../..', 'node_modules'),
  ];
```
Resolved in 2289184d0: the legacy registry now uses readOptionalJson with a shape-safe empty registry fallback and records BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_ABSENT. The clean-bootstrap unit test passes.
Resolved in 2289184d0: all five remaining legacy/OSS surfaces now use readOptionalJson with explicit empty-row fallbacks, so missing generated artifacts no longer deadlock completeness generation.

Resolved in 2289184d0: the machine-specific /home/samsen node_modules fallback was removed. Runtime resolution now uses only checkout-local and shared-worktree-relative node_modules paths; portability guard passes.
Resolved in 2289184d0: the completeness PDF runtime no longer contains an absolute local path. Targeted ESLint and the portability regression test pass.

Resolved in 2289184d0: external curl was replaced with shared native fetch. The implementation validates the final redirect host, enforces HTTPS allowlists, a 60s timeout, HTTP errors, Content-Length and streamed-body ceilings; 404, oversize, redirect-authority, and successful receipt tests pass.
